name: RAN Protect an Acre (Community Action Grants)
summary: Small grants from Rainforest Action Network to grassroots, Indigenous and frontline groups in forest regions to protect threatened forests, secure land rights and manage traditional territories. RAN does not consider unsolicited applications.

applicant_types.quote: RAN Community Action Grants provide funding for Indigenous and frontline communities and grassroots initiatives fighting to keep forests standing, protect the climate, and uphold human rights.

geography.quote: Although grants are made in all regions, geographic priority areas are Southeast Asia and South and North America, and projects led by Black, Indigenous, and People of Color are prioritized.

access.quote: Community Action Grants is not able to consider unsolicited applications and does not support individual, governmental, or exclusively academic projects.

amount.quote: These grants (generally $5,000-$15,000) are critical to help local activists regain control of and sustainably manage traditional territories.
